conclusion.overall_answer: Current frozen learned/feature path does not demonstrate reliable leave-one-mechanism-out transfer. Exact recovery is unavailable without a candidate class synthesis mechanism, surrogate family recovery is limited, and OOS false-positive behavior fails as a hard gate for computed dry-run tracks.
conclusion.stop_condition: artifact and report only; no expansion, architecture changes, AF3, or production retraining launched
